issues.message: Only 8 blocks: too bare for a prop (at least 10). Carlton wants more detail, not less.

visual.summary: Notice board level 2: the same with two signs; still tiny and on a raised block.
problems: Far too small (6 to 8 blocks; the automatic check fails it): Carlton called a 2-block signpost "minimal effort trash". Build a proper board: two log posts, a plank board, a little roof.
The gravel pad was meant to replace the ground, but the mod builds layer 0 on top of the ground, so it stands as a raised block and the board floats behind it.
